name: Gamer Bro
tagline: Follows gaming news and deals, and says the moment stock lands
description: It keeps up with releases, price cuts, hardware questions and how to get better at whatever you are playing. body:
## What it does

It keeps up with releases, price cuts, hardware questions and how to get better at whatever you are playing. Alongside that it makes a regular sweep of retailers, checking whether the things on your list have come back into stock or opened for pre-order, and tells you as soon as one can be bought. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @egcbatt shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
